تمتزجن (form VIII)
# تَمْتَزِجْنَ (tamtazijna) /tam.ta.zid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# تُمْتَزَجْنَ (tumtazajna) /tum.ta.zad͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
